audit.why: EVEN 5.5 is slightly conservative against a 55.18% Swain WR over 589 games, but the kit story (his W blunts your burst, his R wins other lanes) justifies not calling it FAVOURED; left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried blanket 'Skill' on rows 0,1,5,6 while content win[] and packet both say Swain; full whys there were generic owner templates.
audit.why: Content and packet agree (Swain, Swain, Skill, Skill, Swain, Swain, Swain). Kit-grounded: Galio's early damage is low and mana-hungry, and post-item Swain's drain grinds a utility tank down while his only poke is an 11s Winds of War.
audit.corrected: Rows 0,1,5,6 moved to Swain with rewritten whys grounded in Galio's kit; rows 2,3,4 already agreed. win[] already correct — side+why edits only.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; the Colossal Smash auto-reset tell (missingInteractions) was nowhere on the page. The second missing interaction claims Justice Punch 'creates a wall', but Riot's E text describes only a charge-knockup — the terrain flag looks like a tooltip misparse, so I did not assert a wall.
audit.why: Kit: Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7s dash-knockup; Shield of Durand 18s rank 1 taunt+shield; Hero's Entrance 180s rank 1 global with an allied shield; Colossal Smash is a periodic auto-reset AoE.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers written in; auto-reset tell carried by dontsFull[2].d; terrain claim left off the page and recorded here.

edits.before: Q-poke through the wave — the hand hurts more than people remember. Farm safely; your real spells arrive next.
edits.after: Your double-Q out-trades his weak, mana-hungry early poke — chip him at wave contact before Winds of War ranks up.

edits.before: E online: the root that defines the lane. Land it and the Q follow-up chunks; miss it and you farm for fourteen seconds.
edits.after: E online and he has no real answer yet: root his step-up and the Q follow-up chunks a melee tank with one poke spell.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the drain outpaces their damage in any extended fight. Force rivers, root the entry, ascend, profit.
edits.after: Liandry's grinds the utility tank down: his W shield can't blunt a drain that never stops. Track his R before you commit.

edits.before: Late Swain is the anti-team: flank-root their engage, ascend in their backline, and demonflare the clump that forms around you.
edits.after: Late you still out-drain his low solo damage — dodge the W taunt, save E for Justice Punch, and fight where your team follows.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Nevermove spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — an 11s dash-knockup at rank 1: he has no engage while it is down and it governs your forward steps. - Shield of Durand's taunt is 18s at rank 1 — with both down, he cannot start anything at all.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Ascension drains minions too — fighting inside your wave feeds the heal, and his AoE-hungry kit must choose between you and the creeps.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: Colossal Smash is an auto-reset AoE that returns every few seconds — its wind-up is your cue to step off before it lands.

notes: Missing interaction 'Justice Punch creates a wall / hold Flash for the wall' was NOT written to the page: Galio's E per Riot's text is a charge that knocks up the first champion hit — the kit's terrain flag looks like a tooltip misparse, and I could not verify any wall-creation. Rows 2, 3, 4 of the chart already agreed and were left. Galio Q is a projectile pair but Swain has nothing it blocks; Swain's E is a projectile and Galio has no projectile-blocker — no interaction to add either way.
